name: run-experiment
description: One experiment end-to-end (PLAN.md 2.2). Runs as a spawn child of the orchestrator (one lineage). Args are positional ($1 parent_id / $2 seed idea_id or 'none' / $3 lineage). THE RECURSION: MUTATE spawns the SAMPLED CONFIG ITSELF (command_name = the parent's flowchart_entry, search_path = the parent bundle's own flowchart/ dir, model = its main_model) handed prompts/mutate-config.md as its message, with the parent's kb/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md appended. IDEA GENERATION: the mutator GENERATES its own hypotheses (>= IDEA_GEN_MIN), deposits the promising ones via ideas.py propose, and claims the one it tests; $2 is only an inspiration seed and may be 'none'. PREP_MUTATE_ARGS assembles the evidence pack (config_evidence.py) + seed text + model allowlist into the prompt. VALIDATE_MODELS gates on models.json before the eval is paid for (the old 'keep/discard IS the validation' stance predates the mutator inventing its own model ids). IDEA_RECORD is deterministic bookkeeping OUTSIDE the mutator - the mutator runs the parent's own flowchart, which we do not author, so the tried-record cannot depend on model compliance. Requires flowcoder-core >= 96ae035 for SpawnBlock.search_path; on older engines BlockBase is extra="ignore" and search_path is SILENTLY DROPPED. All data paths honor AUTORES_ROOT.

arguments.name: parent_id
arguments.description: id of the parent bundle to mutate ($1)

arguments.name: lineage
arguments.description: lineage label for idea-pool attribution, e.g. lineage-2 ($3)

prep_parent_dir.name: PREP_PARENT_DIR
prep_parent_dir.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
P="$AR/dict/configs/$1"
test -f "$P/manifest.json" || { echo "run-experiment: parent bundle not found: $P" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "$P"

prep_entry.name: PREP_PARENT_ENTRY
prep_entry.command:
set -eu
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
"$PY" - "{{parent_dir}}/manifest.json" <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, sys
m = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
entry = m.get("flowchart_entry") or ""
if not entry:
    raise SystemExit("run-experiment: parent manifest has no flowchart_entry")
print(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(entry))[0])
PYEOF

prep_model.name: PREP_PARENT_MODEL
prep_model.command:
set -eu
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
"$PY" - "{{parent_dir}}/manifest.json" <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
m = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print(m.get("main_model") or "")   # empty -> spawn inherits the session model
PYEOF

prep_args.name: PREP_MUTATE_ARGS
prep_args.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SEED="$AR/dict/configs/optimizer-seed"
SCRIPTS="$SEED/scripts"
"$PY" - "$SCRIPTS" "$SEED/prompts/mutate-config.md" "{{parent_dir}}" "{{out_dir}}" "$1" "${2:-none}" "${3:-lineage-1}" "$PY" <<'PYEOF'
import os, shlex, sys
scripts, tmpl, parent_dir, out_dir, parent_id, seed_id, lineage, py = sys.argv[1:9]
sys.path.insert(0, scripts)
import config_evidence, ideas, models_lib, tunables

seed_id = "" if seed_id.strip() in ("", "-", "none") else seed_id.strip()
entry = ideas.fold().get(seed_id) if seed_id else None
seed_text = (f"`{seed_id}`: {entry['text']}" if entry
             else "(nothing queued - generate unseeded)")

msg = open(tmpl, encoding="utf-8").read()
for k, v in (("@@PARENT_DIR@@", parent_dir), ("@@OUT_DIR@@", out_dir),
             ("@@CAND_ID@@", os.path.basename(out_dir)), ("@@PARENT_ID@@", parent_id),
             ("@@LINEAGE@@", lineage), ("@@SEED_IDEA@@", seed_text),
             ("@@EVIDENCE@@", config_evidence.build(parent_id)),
             ("@@AVAILABLE_MODELS@@", models_lib.render_for_prompt()),
             ("@@IDEA_GEN_MIN@@", str(tunables.idea_gen_min())),
             ("@@SCRIPTS@@", scripts), ("@@PY@@", py)):
    msg = msg.replace(k, v)
# The config's KB rides in the message: this spawn runs the bundle's flowchart,
# and a spawn does not attach kb/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md as a system prompt the way the
# eval adapter does, so without this the KB half of the config would be lost.
kb_path = os.path.join(parent_dir, "kb", "SYSTEM_PROMPT.md")
kb = open(kb_path, encoding="utf-8").read() if os.path.isfile(kb_path) else ""
if kb.strip():
    msg += "\n\nKnowledge base: " + kb
print(" ".join(["''"] * 4 + [shlex.quote(msg), "''"]))
PYEOF

idea_record.name: IDEA_RECORD
idea_record.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS="$AR/dict/configs/optimizer-seed/scripts"
"$PY" - "$SCRIPTS" "{{out_dir}}" "${2:-none}" <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, sys
scripts, out_dir, seed_id = sys.argv[1:4]
sys.path.insert(0, scripts)
import ideas
dec = json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(out_dir.rstrip("/")), "decision.json")))
tested = (dec.get("idea_id") or "").strip()
if tested:
    ideas.complete(tested, dec.get("candidate_id", ""), dec.get("cand_score"),
                   bool(dec.get("kept")))
seed_id = "" if seed_id.strip() in ("", "-", "none") else seed_id.strip()
if seed_id and seed_id != tested:
    # The seed was consumed for inspiration but never itself evaluated.
    ideas.seeded(seed_id, tested or dec.get("candidate_id", ""))
print(json.dumps({"tested": tested, "seed": seed_id}))
PYEOF

validate_models.name: VALIDATE_MODELS
validate_models.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS="$AR/dict/configs/optimizer-seed/scripts"
# Gate BEFORE the eval: the mutator now invents its own model ids, so the
# allowlist is the only thing between a hallucinated model and a paid run.
# continue_on_error=false — fail the lineage cheaply. The claimed idea is left
# `present` and the IDEA_STALE_SECONDS reaper returns it to `future`.
"$PY" "$SCRIPTS/validate_models.py" "{{out_dir}}"
